notes.title: New Language Option Update
notes.notes: We're thrilled to announce a significant update to Find with Seoul. We have now added language options to the game. This new feature will allow you to separately configure the language for text and voiceover. This addition was made in response to player feedback, and we believe it will significantly improve your gaming experience. As always, we're committed to providing a game that is accessible and enjoyable to a wide audience, and we're grateful for your ongoing support. Stay tuned for more updates!
